title: Knowledge UUID Migration
outcome_summary: Migrated all knowledge insight IDs from per-store auto-increment numeric values to UUID v4 strings, eliminating cross-store collisions and enabling stable IDs across move/promote operations. The migration covered 9 production source files, 12 test files, 5 manifest documents, and all 10 live knowledge store files (159 insights) across two storage locations, with the full 4031-test suite passing clean. Two code-review rework cycles caught a latent XSS vulnerability and a GUI parseInt regression before they reached production.
project_summary: Replace the per-store auto-increment numeric ID on knowledge insights with a UUID v4 string identifier, eliminating cross-store ID collisions and enabling stable IDs across moves and copies. All known stores are migrated via a one-time batch script, and the schema version bumps from 1.0.0 to 2.0.0.
